scope: Independent computational, symbolic, unit, and diagram-content audit

evidence: Recomputed $2^x$ and $3^x$ tables; points, intercept, domain, range, and $y=0$ asymptote agree.

Verified each logarithmic statement is equivalent to its exponential form with unchanged base and exponent.
Recomputed $\log(250)=2.397940$ and $\ln(40)=3.688879$; inverse checks return 250 and 40.
Derived domain $(-1,\infty)$, asymptote $x=-1$, y-intercept $(0,2)$, and x-intercept $(-3/4,0)$.
Solved $\log_2(x-5)=4$ as $x=21$ and confirmed the log argument is positive.
Verified line, ray, segment, and angle notation, including ray endpoint A and angle vertex B.
Verified vertical angles are equal and adjacent linear-pair angles sum to $180^\circ$.
Solved both congruent and supplementary parallel-line equations by substitution.
Verified octagon sum $1080^\circ$, regular 15-gon interior angle $156^\circ$, trapezoid area 112, and parallelogram area 72 square units.
Verified independent quadrilateral areas 44 and 36, compound areas 82 and 124, regular 12-gon sum 1800 and angle 150, pentagon missing angle 115, and exit trapezoid area 55.
Recomputed equilateral area $640000\sqrt3=1108512.52$ square kilometers.
Recomputed Heron area $12\sqrt5=26.83$ square units.
Verified right-triangle height 12 and area 54 square units from base 9 and hypotenuse 15.
Verified added Heron model $6\sqrt6\approx14.70$, 8-15-17 area 60, and mixed areas 35, $9\sqrt3$, and 12 square units.
Cross-multiplication gives $x=15$; DMS conversions give $45.371667^\circ$ and $73^\circ37'30''$.
Verified shrinking sides $26/3$ and $28/3$, enlargement sides 8.75 and 22.75, and geometric agreement of all rounded angle labels.
Verified $135.721^\circ=135^\circ43'15.6''$, reverse DMS result $120.813889^\circ$, and nautical-mile conversions 9.26 and approximately 11.112 km.
Verified compound-area subtraction: 130 square units in the model and 96 square units in practice.
Verified circumference doubles, area quadruples, and annulus areas are differences of squared radii.
Verified inscribed angle $55^\circ$, chord angle $60^\circ$, and intercepted practice arc $74^\circ$.
Verified $120^\circ=2\pi/3$, $s=8\pi$, sector area $48\pi$, and practice arc $2\pi$.
Verified $v=12$ ft/s and $d=120$ ft in the model; practice rim speed is 2.8 m/s.
Verified hollow-cylinder material volume $70\pi$; practice cylinder volume $90\pi$ and surface area $78\pi$.
Verified central/inscribed result 62°, triangle angle 75°, and remaining arc 150° from arc AB 78° and angle ABC 66°.
Verified both DMS directions, nearest-second rounding, four-decimal degree answers, and 137.6° = 2.402 rad to three decimals.
Verified arc 8.4, sector 25.2, inverse radii 54/π and 36/π, inverse angle 4.425 rad ≈ 253.53°, and corrected sprinkler area 500π/3.
Verified diameter-to-radius conversion, 144°/s and 24π/5 ft/s in the model, plus 180°/s and 4π ft/s in practice.
Recomputed quarterly balance $A=3408.53$ and monthly practice balance $A=7277.59$.
Verified $5\pi/6=150^\circ$, model arc $6\pi$, and practice arc $8\pi/3\approx8.38$.
Verified trapezoid area 91, similarity result $x=10$, and linear speed 2 m/s.
Verified $225^\circ$ and $-120^\circ$ terminate in Quadrant III; $310^\circ$ terminates in Quadrant IV.
Verified degree coterminals $263^\circ,-457^\circ,45^\circ$ and radian coterminals $23\pi/7,-5\pi/7$.
Verified model arc $8\pi$ and practice arc $6\pi$ after degree-to-radian conversion.
Verified the 9-40-41 Pythagorean triple and all six reciprocal trigonometric ratios.
Recomputed ladder height $25\sin70^\circ=23.49$ ft.
Verified reference angles $30^\circ,50^\circ,60^\circ,\pi/4$, and practice angle $40^\circ$.
Intersected sign quadrants: tangent positive and cosine negative gives Quadrant III; sine positive and secant negative gives Quadrant II.
Verified point-radius calculations and all six signs/ratios for $(-3,4)$ and $(-2,-5)$; $\sin240^\circ=-\sqrt3/2$.
Recomputed model area 346.40 and practice area 57.85 square units.
Recomputed corrected ladder height $20\sin65^\circ=18.13$ ft and practice height 72.03 ft.
Recomputed 300-mile components: east 271.89, north 126.79.
Solved shared-height equations: closer distance 41.37 ft, farther distance 91.37 ft, and height 54.90 ft.
Verified terminal-minus-initial gives $\langle5,-6\rangle$ and practice gives $\langle6,3\rangle$.
Verified $u+v=\langle2,3\rangle$, $3u-2v=\langle11,-16\rangle$, and practice $2u-3v=\langle7,-18\rangle$.
Verified model magnitude 5 and direction $126.87^\circ$; practice magnitude $3\sqrt5$ and direction $26.57^\circ$.
Verified 9-40-41 ratios, coterminal angle $263^\circ$, reference angle $83^\circ$, and $\sin225^\circ=-\sqrt2/2$.
Verified missing leg $4\sqrt{69}\approx33.23$, angles $18.32^\circ,71.68^\circ$, area 346.40, and two-observation height 54.90 ft.
Verified $\langle-5,5\rangle$, magnitude $5\sqrt2$, and direction $135^\circ$.
